title: Music: what to build the next tracks from
question: You asked what made the current music sound better than the new rounds. The full-bodied intro is the opening theme: a complete song with vocals, made locally with YuE2 and mastered (art/approved/music/opening.mp3). The background loops, including the menu's 'calm', are short 30-second Lyria 2 clips. Rounds 3 to 5 tried to reach the opening theme's fullness with short instrumental loops (local ACE-Step, then Lyria 3 Pro), and fell short. Your round-5 picks (evening-2, office-2, shops-1) are kept as fallbacks. Which direction for the next round? Budget: about $14 left on Replicate; options 1 and 2 run locally at no cost.

options.label: Build from the opening theme
options.note: Recommended. Take the opening theme's melody and sound: its instrumental with the vocals removed (Demucs) for the title, plus instrumental variations of it made with YuE2 (the instrumental add-on that stops the singing) for day, evening, office and shops. In September the best local result was YuE2 with the voice removed. Local, no cost; at most 5 pieces.

options.label: New YuE2 instrumentals in the opening's style
options.note: Same model and style tags as the opening theme, but new pieces rather than variations of its melody. Local, no cost; at most 5 pieces.

options.label: Keep trying Lyria 3 Pro with new prompts
options.note: About $0.10 a piece. Rounds 4 and 5 used this; quality was fine but the pieces didn't land.

options.label: Use the round-5 fallbacks for now
options.note: Put evening-2, office-2 and shops-1 in the game now, and leave the title and day music as they are.
